note: Our app's column in the feature matrix comes from the app itself, checked on a Pixel 10 emulator during the 17 Sep 2026 QA round (see the Status Saver tab), not from its Play listing text. A listing can understate or overstate what ships; the emulator cannot.

evidence.Statuses: photos and videos: Both sources checked on the emulator: images and videos, WhatsApp and Business
evidence.Original quality, no watermark: Saved files compared with the originals byte for byte
evidence.Sticker packs: Bundled packs with Add to WhatsApp from the pack screen
evidence.Multiple languages: 9 languages including Urdu and Arabic, right-to-left layout checked
evidence.Offline viewing: Home reached in about 6.7 s with no network, saving still worked
evidence.Remove ads purchase: Premium: weekly Rs 1,100, monthly Rs 2,750 (Pakistan store)
evidence.Folder access, no all-files permission: Folder access through the system picker; READ_MEDIA_IMAGES and READ_MEDIA_VIDEO removed in fix round 2
evidence.Auto-save new statuses: Not built: every save is a deliberate tap
evidence.Multi-select save: Not built: one status at a time
evidence.Private vault or lock: Not built; the old paywall row claiming a private vault was removed in fix round 2
evidence.Recover deleted messages: Deliberately not built and never claimed: the category's riskiest claim

ships: WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business statuses, images and videos, read through folder access granted by the system picker — no all-files permission, and no media permission on Android 13+.
Saving that does not touch the file
Saved to Pictures and Movies, byte-identical to the original. Checked by comparing the saved file with the source during QA.
Full-screen viewer with repost, share, save and delete. Repost and Add to WhatsApp hand off to WhatsApp itself.
Everything saved stays in the app's own list, with favourites — which most of the shelf does not offer.
Bundled sticker packs that can be added to WhatsApp from the pack screen.
Including Urdu and Arabic with right-to-left layouts, plus new-status notifications.
Ads, and a way to switch them off
Ad-supported with a rewarded opt-in before saving; Premium removes all ads (weekly or monthly).
